title: Predictor Experiments — Closing the Blueprint Gaps
summary_zh: 解析式 LLM 推論時間預測器的實驗結果報告，逐一補齊核心審視的審查缺口。第一波四個本機（無 GPU）實驗：E1.1 整合修正後全步 prefill MAPE 由 22.83% 降至 17.34%（RF 上限 2.70%，n=18,601 cell）；E1.2 波量化 $\eta_{wave}$ 推廣至 non-persistent 核（A100-80 LOO 5.77%、L40S 2.85%）但不適用於 Hopper 的 persistent 核；E1.5 五因子效率瀑布精確閉合（殘差 7.9e-5），時脈為 4 SKU 中 3 個的最大拉低項；E2.2 純規格 m2 在四方 SKU 選擇達 top-1 100%、Spearman +1.00、0 列 profiling。五個 PACE 實驗（E1.3 L2、E1.4 alpha、E1.6 Blackwell、E2.1 跨 GPU 遷移、E2.3 QLM 即時）標註為進行中並附完整設計、不杜撰結果。
summary_en: An experiment results report for the analytical LLM-inference-time predictor, closing the Core Review's audit gaps. The first local (no-GPU) wave: E1.1 integrates the fixes and drops full-step prefill MAPE from 22.83% to 17.34% (RF ceiling 2.70%, n=18,601 cells); E1.2 shows wave-quantization $\eta_{wave}$ generalizes to non-persistent kernels (A100-80 LOO 5.77%, L40S 2.85%) but not to Hopper's persistent kernel; E1.5 closes the five-factor efficiency waterfall exactly (residual 7.9e-5), with clock the largest pull-down on 3/4 SKUs; E2.2 has spec-only m2 score 100% top-1 and +1.00 Spearman from zero profiling rows on 4-way SKU selection. Five PACE experiments (E1.3 L2, E1.4 alpha, E1.6 Blackwell, E2.1 cross-GPU transfer, E2.3 QLM-live) are marked in-flight with full designs and no fabricated results.
